name: 敵_騎馬兵_やられ_4コマ_v2.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one 384px-per-frame 2D beat-em-up sprite strip.
Primary request: Create enemy mounted cavalryman (figure 7 in supplied eight-enemy sheet) falling rider alone, NO horse in any frame. This is a different rider from the horn-helmet cape samurai: simple black conical jingasa, blue-gray tunic, dark scale armor, plain boots, long straight spear. Match supplied sheet's face, costume, colors and detailed painted game style.
Four-frame continuous death/fall reaction: 1 impact onto right-facing side, spear drops beside him; 2 rolls onto back and draws knees in; 3 shoulder and boots give a small rebound; 4 lies still curled on side. Rider facing RIGHT and same anatomical scale and consistent head/torso. Entire rider and complete spear visible in every pose, centered within each of four equal 384-square cells, generous margins. One rider per cell, no horse.
One horizontal strip exactly 1536x384, four equal cells. Solid pure RGB(255,0,255) magenta background everywhere. No text, no cell borders, grid, cast shadow or ground.
